description: A .sh hook without its executable bit cannot be run: it is logged as exit 126 and the next hook runs.

expect.log:
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 (hook_pre_noexec.sh, timeout 60s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 exited non-zero [ 126 ]; continuing

[ pfB Hook ] pre #1 (hook_pre_ok.sh, timeout 60s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #1 completed
expect.errors: [ pfB Hook ] pre #0 exited non-zero [ 126 ]; continuing
expect.transcript:
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 (hook_pre_noexec.sh, timeout 60s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 exited non-zero [ 126 ]; continuing

[ pfB Hook ] pre #1 (hook_pre_ok.sh, timeout 60s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #1 completed

departure: Today timeout(1) itself reports the failed exec in the hook's output; Go writes no output for a hook that never started.

old_expect.log:
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 (hook_pre_noexec.sh, timeout 60s)
timeout: failed to run command '{root}/hooks/hook_pre_noexec.sh': Permission denied
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 exited non-zero [ 126 ]; continuing

[ pfB Hook ] pre #1 (hook_pre_ok.sh, timeout 60s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #1 completed
